title: What is ß?
content: The letter ß is called Eszett or scharfes S. It is pronounced like a sharp “ss”. It appears after long vowels and diphthongs: heißen, Straße, groß.
After a short vowel, write ss: muss, Fluss. In Switzerland, ß is not used; people write ss everywhere. In capitals, ß may be written SS (or ẞ).
